scenario: [LSER.16.3.1] / [LSER.14.1]: `variance` and `stdev` are the SAMPLE statistics (n - 1), Python `statistics` naming, exact over the all-time history on the running-stats backing (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma, [LSER.18.1]). Values 1, 5, 9 then 10, one per pump, each read pre-sample ([LSER.8.6.1]); the guard `s.count >= 3` makes the one read that logs the one over [1, 5, 9]: mean 5, squared deviations 16 + 0 + 16 = 32, so `variance` = 32 / 2 = 16.0 and `stdev` = 4.0. Every intermediate of Welford's update on these inputs is an integer, so the value is exact in either formulation and the two runtimes must print the same text. Drives libds `welford_ewma.c`'s m2 / (w - 1) and the Mercury `ds.series` `variance(_, _, 1)`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    count, variance, stdev all_time

rule r:
    Reading s where s.count >= 3
->
    log info "var {s.variance} stdev {s.stdev}"
